rule: AVB -> FAIL if the strongest binding-event Synchformer reading (action-window mode, window_if_alone_multi) has |offset| >= T and probability >= P; otherwise keep the media-only anchor verdict
derived_on: P01/P02 v3-test B rows (anchor_1030), action-window Synchformer
derivation: T = 95th pct of |offset| on originals (0.2 s grid); P = 5th pct of p among shifted rows with |offset| > T (0.01)
holdout_criterion: pass if broken holdout originals <= round(0.05 * n_holdout_originals) (originals with an anchor verdict), with the rule applied in code to the same-day holdout anchor
